newsitem.title: USA: Delaware court reinstates lawsuit vs Arvida/JMB.
newsitem.headline: Delaware court reinstates lawsuit vs Arvida/JMB.

text.p: Arvida/JMB Partners LP lost another legal battle in its effort to block financier Leon Black's bid to buy 22 percent of Arvida's outstanding limited partnership real estate units.

According to court papers made available Friday, the Delaware Supreme Court reversed a lower court ruling and reinstated a lawsuit in which Black's Raleigh Capital Associates LP is seeking to block Arvida's $160 million refinancing loan from Starwood/Florida Funding LLC.
The money was to have been distributed as interest to unit holders.

In a separate but related case, an Illinois court has already ordered Arvida not to proceed with the loan, saying the financing had been arranged "for the purpose of maintaining (Arvida's) position as general partner."

On Tuesday, Raleigh said it would extend to midnight January 15 its unsolicited offer to pay $500 per partnership unit. Arvida turned down previous offers as inadequate. Earlier this year Lehman Brothers said the liquidation value of the partnership was $565 to $610 a unit.
Arvida/JMB is a Boca Raton, Florida-based residential developer.
